Great burgers and fair prices, service could improve!
Mar 2026 • Solo
I really enjoyed the food here. The burgers are very good and the price-to-quality ratio is excellent for the An Bang Beach area. The outdoor seating area is also relaxed and comfortable, making it a nice place to sit and enjoy a casual meal.

The only downside is the service. The staff appear friendly at first, but it sometimes feels a bit “fake-friendly” and not very attentive. During both of my visits, staff members were occasionally on their phones while the restaurant was quite busy. I mean, seriously?

Small details also show this lack of attention. For example, on both occasions my burger arrived before the drinks. Not a big issue, but it reflects the overall service experience.

That said, the food and the prices are good enough that I came back a second time. With a bit more attentive service, this place could easily be a 5-star spot.
